notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
Patch 1.02 Released
Patch 1.01 Released
notes.notes:
Pathologic Classic HD Patch 1.01 is up now. The launch of the game was generally smooth, so we're blessed with a relatively short fix list for our first patch. Nothing major has changed.

Patch Notes:
— [Audio] OpenAL bug fixed; the audio is playing normally now, leaving no one with an uncannily mute game.
— [Audio] Firestarters sound volume fixed. There'll be no more ridiculously loud cries from any distance upon firestarters being disturbed.
— [Video] Codec notification added. If you're unable to launch the game properly for the lack of codecs, the game will now notify you of this so that fixing the issue would be easier.
— [Text] A number of text bugs and typos fixed, including several embarrassing ones.
